title: 15.36TB 3D TLC PCIe 3.1 x4 NVMe U.2 SSD for Dell EMC PowerEdge Servers | Enterprise Drive in 14G 15G Tray
description:
15.36TB NVMe SSD compatible in Dell servers with 2.5in SFF chassis and NVMe-capable backplanes.
Equipped with a 14th gen. Dell hot-plug caddy, forwards compatible in 15th gen. PowerEdge servers.
Designed for 24x7 availability in high data-workload environments.
Enterprise-grade reliability and performance, optimized for scale-out data centers.
Backed by a 2-year replacement warranty.
There are a number of backplane and riser combinations offered for 14th & 15th Generation PowerEdge Servers. Specific options are required for NVMe PCIe U.2 SSD enablement.
